units.source_text: 但是，等她敲门的时候，来开门的竟然是表兄。

en.t: But when she knocked at the door, the person who came to open it was, unexpectedly, her cousin.

units.source_text: 看到久违的信子，俊吉如以往一般开心的叫“呀——”，

en.t: Seeing Nobuko again after so long, Shunkichi happily called out, "Hey!" just as he always had,

units.source_text: 信子这才注意到，俊吉不再是从前一般的寸头了。

en.t: and only then did Nobuko notice that Shunkichi no longer had the close-cropped hair he used to have.
"It really has been a long time."

units.source_text: “快点请进来，不过十分不巧，照子不在家，现在只有我自己。”

en.t: "Please, come in. Unfortunately, Teruko is not home; I am the only one here right now."
"She went out on an errand with the maid."

units.source_text: 信子感觉到一种莫名其妙的羞耻感，

en.t: Nobuko felt an inexplicable sense of shame,

units.source_text: 她默默脱掉那件镶着华丽里子的大衣，挂在玄关的一角。

en.t: and silently took off the overcoat with its gorgeous lining and hung it in a corner of the entryway.
